key_impacts: Widespread loss of life and property; basic services disrupted for months in Uttarakhand.
Floodwaters from the Mandakini swept across Kedarnath, killing people including a 16-year-old student.
Children and adolescents were among the hardest hit.
Families lost breadwinners, threatening children’s education due to financial hardship.
evidence_snippets: The June 2013 floods and landslides in Uttarakhand... one of the most debilitating disasters.
On 17th June 2013, a raging Mandakini river... swept across Kedarnath swallowing Anil along with many others.
Loss of life and property along with the disruption of basic services... for months.
missing_information: Exact death toll and damage figures not provided.

affected_locations: State Primary School at Farkia, Chamoli district, Uttarakhand
key_impacts: Classes disrupted; school operated from two makeshift locations, then moved to Panchayat premises with poor conditions, impeding teaching and learning.
evidence_snippets: The July 13 landslide has transformed this school's building into a pile of rubble.
The school had to be operated from two makeshift locations in the village.
From 13th August onwards, this school was shifted to the premises of the Panchayat... impediment for teachers to teach.
missing_information: Casualty numbers and broader damage details not provided.
